title: Audit all app features as user stories
goal: Inventory every user-facing feature in the Worksheet Universe app, record each as a user story with expected behavior in one canonical spreadsheet, test each story, document errors, fix logistical or UX errors, and retest the stories after fixes.
context: The user requested a full feature/user-story audit followed by browser behavior testing, error documentation, UX/logistics fixes, and post-fix retesting. Worksheet JSON remains the canonical source of truth.
acceptance: A single canonical spreadsheet tracks each feature, user story, expected behavior, status, test evidence, defects, fixes, and retest result
Every user-facing feature discoverable from the code is represented by at least one user story
Automated checks and browser behavior tests are run against the recorded stories
Logistical or UX errors found during testing are documented and fixed where safe within scope
Every fixed behavior is retested and the spreadsheet/report reflect the final status
notes: Do not add auth, accounts, databases, LMS integrations, OCR, complex PDF generation, or non-JSON worksheet content paths.
